code_inspection.mutation_behavior: Mutates the paths accumulator by appending completed paths. Preserves input non-mutation for path prefix via [...path] clone. Does not mutate startVertex, its neighbors, or the graph.
code_inspection.external_dependencies: GraphVertex.prototype.getKey and GraphVertex.prototype.getNeighbors. Deterministic, synchronous in-memory traversal without global state or I/O.
